instruction:
Task: Click a UI button or checkbox to toggle a pre-defined animation (e.g., pulsating or rotating) on the selected circle.
Expected Result: The selected circle begins to animate (e.g., pulsate or rotate) if it was static, or stops animating if it was already animating. The UI control reflects the current animation state.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
